maintenanceNotes.eslint: Pinned to latest 9.x. eslint-config-next@16.3.3 still bundles eslint-plugin-react@7.37.5, whose eslint peer range caps at ^9.7, so eslint@10 crashes with `contextOrFilename.getFilename is not a function`. Re-evaluate when eslint-config-next ships a plugin bundle that supports ESLint 10 rule context API.
maintenanceNotes.typescript: Pinned to latest 6.x. eslint-config-next@16.3.3 pulls typescript-eslint@8.68.0, whose typescript peer range is >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, so TS 7.x is unsupported. Re-evaluate when typescript-eslint ships TS 7 support (typescript-eslint#10940).
maintenanceNotes.@types/node: Kept on the 25.x line to match the Node 24 runtime in Dockerfile. Do not jump to @types/node@26 unless the image moves to Node 26.
maintenanceNotes.prisma: Held on 7.x. prisma@8 is only available as a prerelease (8.0.0-rc). Re-evaluate when 8.0.0 is stable.

overridesNote.postcss: Forces next/vite/tailwind onto postcss >=8.5.26 (source-map path traversal). Re-evaluate when next ships postcss >=8.5.26 transitively. Must stay in lockstep with the direct devDependency `postcss` range below (autoprefixer requires postcss as a peer dep), or npm throws EOVERRIDE.
overridesNote.deepmerge-ts: Forces @prisma/config (which pins deepmerge-ts to an exact 7.1.5) onto >=8.0.2 (GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx, stack exhaustion on recursive object graphs). `npm audit fix` would instead downgrade prisma to 6.12.0 -- do not run it. Drop this override once @prisma/config pins deepmerge-ts >=8.
